name: resistance band fingers extension
description: Opening your fingers against a band strengthens the small extensor muscles of the hand and forearm. It is a good balance for all the gripping you do.
instructions: Loop a light band around your fingers and thumb of one hand.
Rest your forearm on a table or your thigh.
Start with the fingers curled in a relaxed fist.
Spread your fingers open against the band's pull.
Close them back slowly with control.
Do all reps, then switch hands.
